features: Mini PC & NAS Hybrid: Unique dual-function design serves as a powerful Mini PC for everyday computing and an expandable Network Attached Storage (NAS) server for centralized data backup and media streaming.
Unprecedented Storage Capacity: Features Quad M.2 Slots for NVMe SSDs, allowing massive storage expansion up to a colossal 16TB total, perfect for large media libraries and business data.

Ultra-Fast Dual 2.5G LAN: Equipped with Dual 2.5G Ethernet ports (using i226 chip), providing ultra-fast, stable wired connectivity for server/NAS functions, high-speed data transfer, and network redundancy.
Efficient Core Performance: Driven by the modern N150 processor, delivering excellent power efficiency and reliable speed for seamless multitasking and 4K content handling.
Next-Gen Speed Memory: Comes with 12GB of LPDDR5 RAM, offering superior speed (4800 MHz) and efficiency over older DDR4, guaranteeing quick system responsiveness and smooth operations.
Future-Proof Wireless: Integrated Wi-Fi 6 technology delivers faster wireless speeds, lower latency, and enhanced stability for streaming and data access across your network.
4K Display Output: Easily connect to modern monitors and TVs via HDMI, supporting crystal-clear 4K resolution perfect for video playback, presentations, or digital signage.
Versatile Connectivity: Includes multiple USB 3.2 ports for rapid peripheral connections and a Type-C port with Power Delivery (PD) for flexible power options.
Optimized for 24/7 Operation: The highly efficient platform and robust cooling design make the Nebula ideal for continuous, always-on operation as a secure home server or NAS device.
OS Flexibility: Supports a variety of operating systems including Windows, Linux (like Ubuntu, available as an option), and specialized NAS platforms for comprehensive data management.
